long_biography.plain_text:
Tarantelli joined Schroders in 1986 and advanced from chief executive of its Italian business to leadership of continental European investment banking and global equities. Following Citi's purchase of the investment-bank operations, he headed European investment banking and later chaired its European global-banking division, working on mergers, equity raisings and privatisations.

In 2011 he left large-bank leadership to co-found Tages with Sergio Ascolani and Salvatore Cordaro. The group began by acquiring alternative-fund businesses, then expanded into distressed credit, infrastructure and private debt. He remains Tages group chief executive and Banca CF+ chairman while serving as chief executive of 21 Next, the private-markets platform that now includes Tages.
